criteria.evidence: Saving with a stale baseRevisionId answers CONFLICT and the editor shows the banner (ADR-0033). server/tests/translation-editor.test.ts (29 passed): the error carries entity 'revision', expected — the fresh revision id, actual — the presented one, and neither the revision nor the translation is written. web/tests/editor-states.test.ts (34 passed) parses the refusal into the fresh revision id and refuses to read a translation-status CONFLICT as a revision conflict; web/tests/editor-components.nuxt.test.ts (12 passed) checks the banner offers both exits and reports the choice. Playwright web/tests/e2e/40-editor-shell.spec.ts against the real API and database: two tabs of one session open one translation, the first saves its edit, the second hits the banner, 'open the fresh version' shows the first tab's text, and after a second conflict 'save a copy as a revision' puts its own text on top of the fresh base revision — the database row holds exactly that text.

Submission without a cover is refused (journal §29.1, article-edit.md §4). server/tests/translation-editor.test.ts: submitTranslation answers VALIDATION_ERROR with field 'cover' and rule 'required' when the article has no cover and rule 'processing' when the media record is not ready; the translation status is not updated in either case. The same file covers the remaining mandatory fields of submission — title, body, section (journal §25.3) — and the review queue: the sixth submission with five translations already in review answers PLAN_LIMIT with limit 5.

Every state row of article-edit.md §8 is reproducible. web/tests/e2e/40-editor-shell.spec.ts (12 passed, Playwright, real API and database), one scenario per row: loading — an in-app navigation with a held response shows the editor skeleton and then the translation title; empty — a fresh draft has an empty title, the cover placeholder, a disabled submit button and the list of missing fields; data error — a translation with no revisions answers 500 for the navigation instead of a skeleton with 200; no access — a guest lands on /login?next= with the return path; not found — an unknown and a stranger's translation both answer 404; plan limit — an expired subscription gives read mode, the banner and the /pricing link with no save or submit buttons; blocked — a restricted session goes to /me/archived and an archived article opens read-only; paywall — no paid-material control is present. The same file also covers read mode for a rejected translation and for ai_check (with the withdraw button) and the full submission path.
